page_title: BBC Learning English - English at Work / The big day
title: The big day
description:
Presentation time! It's a big day for Anna as she presents Tip Top Trading's new Imperial Lemon to Mr Lime at Citrus Ventures. This is her chance to make a big impression on her boss Paul and show that she can really bring in the business. How will her presentation turn out?
This episode focuses on the beginning of a presentation and how to clearly explain what your audience can expect to hear.
phrases: Then I’m going to move on to discuss…

listening_challenge.question: Where is Anna’s presentation taking place?
listening_challenge.answer: In the meeting room at Citrus Ventures.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Hello, welcome to the offices of Citrus Ventures! It's a big day for Anna, she's about to present Tip Top Trading's new Imperial Lemon to Mr Lime and his colleagues. This must not go wrong.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: …revoltionary laser-curve.... revolUtionary laser-curve... revol-

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: How are you feeling today Anna?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Scared! I want to do really well. If I mess up and Citrus Ventures doesn't place an order, I'll be so upset.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: You're well prepared, that's the main thing. Explain clearly how your presentation will be organised.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: OK. Oh dear, I didn't think of the very beginning. Can you give me examples of what I should say?

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text:
After you've introduced yourself, you could say:
Today I'm going to... and explain. Then say:
I'll start by...
And then I'm going to move on to discuss…
And finally...

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text:
OK, like this:
Today I'm going to...
I'll start by...
And then I'm going to move on to discuss…
And finally...

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Exactly.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Right, thanks, I'll try. Everything will be fine. I feel relaxed now.

transcript.speaker: Mr Lime
transcript.text: Anna!

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Mr Lime!

transcript.speaker: Mr Lime
transcript.text: How lovely to see you. You look absolutely... I've been looking forward to this for days! Everyone is waiting in the meeting room. Come this way....

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Oh gosh.

transcript.speaker: Mr Lime
transcript.text: Everyone in Citrus Ventures is very excited about this new Imperial Lemon, so I allowed a few extras to come and watch, I hope you don't mind. All your equipment has been set up so you can begin!

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Hello, I'm Anna of Top Tip Trading… I mean, Tip Top Trading, sorry! I'm very unhappy to be here.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Anna- focus!

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: I mean, I'm very happy to be here.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text:
Anna, breathe deeply, then say:
Today I'm going to...

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Today I'm going to... Today I'm going to present our revolutionary, new Imperial Lemon. I'll start by telling you a bit about Tip Top Trading and some of the exciting new developments at our company. And then…I’m going to move on to explain how the Imperial Lemon is designed and what makes it so revolutionary. And finally, you will all have a chance to see it close up for yourselves and ask questions. So, let's begin. This picture shows...

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Well, as usual, Anna seems to be turning a difficult situation into a success. She used the phrases we discussed, which made her opening clear and well-structured. She said:
But that's just the beginning, now she's got to get through the rest of the pitch – how will that go?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: …this picture shows….oh no, why isn’t it working…I should just click on this….oh, what’s wrong with this stupid computer!

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Uh oh! It was all going so well but now Anna’s got computer problems. What is she going to do? We'll find out next time. Bye!
